list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete Cr2Ce2 square linked by nearly linear Cr–F–Ce bridges; the Ce centers carry bidentate nitrate ligands.

synthesis.procedure: The general phenanthroline-series procedure mixed filtered methanolic solutions of cis-[CrF2(phen)2]NO3 and hydrated Ce(NO3)3, then allowed crystals to form at room temperature.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter precursor solution twice; decant suspended byproduct, wash crystals with methanol, and dry under dynamic vacuum; drying causes solvent loss.

properties.summary: Temperature-dependent susceptibility was measured; χT falls steeply at low temperature. No out-of-phase ac susceptibility signal was observed.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A pentanuclear cluster with three Nd centers in a nitrate-bridged equatorial triangle around a central μ3-fluoride, capped above and below by nonchelating {CrF3(Me3tacn)} units.

synthesis.procedure: Allow an acetonitrile solution of fac-[CrF3(Me3tacn)] to diffuse through a porous glass frit into an acetonitrile solution of Nd(NO3)3·6H2O at 5 °C.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: diffusion through a D4 porous glass frit
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Pink rod-shaped crystals develop; gently crush, wash repeatedly with acetonitrile, and store below 0 °C to limit solvent loss.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A solvent-free Cr2Nd2 fluoride-bridged square related to the phenanthroline series; the bipyridine structures crystallize in orthorhombic I222.

synthesis.procedure: The main article says the preparation proceeds similarly to the phenanthroline analogues, but places its details in the unsupplied Supporting Information.
synthesis.time: 30 min cooling; 30 min stirring after mixing
synthesis.vessel_or_method: mixing separately prepared methanolic solutions followed by precipitation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter the chromium solution through a 0.22 μm Teflon filter before mixing. Isolate the precipitate by filtration, wash repeatedly with methanol (4 × 5 mL), and air-dry.
